textual.observation: The speaker describes paying 240 RUB into a two-day tariff and receiving a stated 20% profit of 40 RUB, then recommends that viewers try the project.

evidence.quote: I paid 240 rubles. I invested according to the first tariff plan, this is for 2 days. And I received profit of 20%, ie 40 rubles.
I recommend this project to earn in the Internet, try it, and get a good price.

textual.context: Promotional context is present; the speaker presents the payment and profit as a personal experience and recommends the project.
textual.potential_relevance: A stated monetary return is linked to paying or investing and to encouraging viewers to try the project, so the return claim and transaction relationship may require later context assessment.
textual.limitations: The records do not establish that the payment, profit, or withdrawal occurred, or that viewers could obtain the same result.

textual.observation: The description provides a URL containing a referral parameter and states REFBACK 50%, while the ASR directs viewers to the description link and mentions 50% off.

evidence.quote: Follow the link in the description of the video or follow me on ibex. It's 50% off, thanks for watching and see you later.

textual.context: The source presents this as a promotional or referral offer; whether REFBACK and 50% off describe the same benefit is unclear.
textual.potential_relevance: A requested click on a referral-linked destination is associated with a stated 50% benefit, making the relationship between the action, destination, and benefit relevant for later review.
textual.limitations: The records do not establish what the 50% benefit means, whether it applies to viewers, or whether the URL or offer is valid.

visual.observation: A webpage labeled "Crypto Pay" states in Russian: "Приумножь свой капитал! Получайте от 20% до 60% чистой прибыли" and lists deposit amounts from 10 to 50,000 RUB, with plans shown as "LIGHT +20%", "PREMIUM +35%", and "EXPERT +60%". It also states that interest is credited every 12–6 hours and becomes available for withdrawal immediately.
visual.context: Visible promotional webpage content for an apparent deposit-based investment offer; the supplied frames do not establish whether the content is an advertisement, demonstration, or discussion.
visual.potential_relevance: The page links specified deposit amounts to promised returns of 20%–60% and rapid withdrawal availability, creating a money-transfer-to-return relationship that may merit review.
visual.limitations: The frames do not establish that any payment was made, that the stated returns were delivered to viewers, or the identity or legitimacy of the operator.

visual.observation: A Crypto Pay account page for the user name "MONEYINVEST" displays "Прибыль с вкладов" of 240.00 RUB and "Выплачено" of 240.00 RUB, while showing zero available balance, zero active deposits, and zero pending withdrawals.
visual.context: Visible logged-in account dashboard; the page presents displayed account figures rather than independently verified transaction outcomes.
visual.potential_relevance: The displayed profit and payout figures are presented in connection with the site's deposit-account interface, reinforcing the advertised return relationship.
visual.limitations: The frames cannot establish whether the displayed figures are genuine, completed, withdrawable, or associated with actual funds.

visual.observation: A Payeer transaction-history screen shows a highlighted incoming amount of approximately 237.74 RUB, and a transaction detail dialog identifies the comment as "Crypto-pay.biz" and the status as completed.
visual.context: Visible payment-service interface and transaction detail used alongside the Crypto Pay account pages; the frames show an apparent payment record, not an independently verified outcome.
visual.potential_relevance: The apparent completed payment bearing the Crypto-pay.biz comment is visually connected to the site's displayed payout claim and may merit review as supporting evidence for the promised-return presentation.
visual.limitations: The frames do not establish the sender's identity, the reason for the payment, whether it was received by the account owner, or whether it resulted from the advertised deposit program.

visual_context_notes.observation: The webpage includes navigation and account-related controls labeled in Russian, including "ТАРИФЫ", "ПЕРЕЙТИ В ЛИЧНЫЙ КАБИНЕТ", "ОТЗЫВЫ", and "МЫ ВКОНТАКТЕ".
The account dashboard visibly includes sections for statistics, profile, referrals, deposits, payouts, and logout.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it promotes a Crypto Pay deposit or investment offer promising a 20% return on a two-day 240-ruble payment, with the webpage advertising returns of 20% to 60% and rapid withdrawals. The speaker recommends that viewers try the project and directs them to a referral-linked URL offering a 50% refback. The displayed profit, payout, and payment records do not independently establish that the advertised returns were genuine or available to viewers, and conflicting statements about payment mean the conclusion rests on the promotional money-to-return relationship rather than verified successful transactions.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The displayed deposit plans link capital participation to advertised percentage returns, and the speaker describes investing in a tariff for a reported profit before recommending the project. The amounts represent investment participation, not a fee for earning guidance.
